description:
pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:576 (active_at) and :596 (expired_at)

Both methods return an Iterator and have no side-effects. Clippy pedantic flags them as 'this method could have a #[must_use] attribute'. Silently discarding the result of either is almost certainly a bug.

  pub fn active_at(&self, now_unix: u64) -> impl Iterator<Item = &Deviation>
  pub fn expired_at(&self, now_unix: u64) -> impl Iterator<Item = &Deviation>

Both should have #[must_use] added.

Also: cabf_tls_br::all_lints() at line 549 is flagged as 'this function could have a #[must_use] attribute' — callers that forget to assign the Vec get silently wasted work.
title: [rusty] pkix-lint: DeviationStore::active_at and expired_at missing #[must_use]
